text: We really need a way to connect TaskFlow to Slack so status changes post automatically to our team channel. Right now we're copy-pasting updates manually every day.
The mobile app crashes every time I try to attach a photo to a task. This is blocking our field crew from logging site issues, please fix ASAP.
Could you add two-factor authentication? Our security team flagged this as a requirement to keep using TaskFlow for client work.
Reporting is really limited right now. We need custom date-range exports and the ability to break down completed tasks by team member.
Billing page shows the wrong plan tier after we upgraded last week. Support has not gotten back to me in 4 days, this is affecting our invoicing.
Please add a Zapier integration, or at minimum webhooks, so we can push task completions into our internal CRM.
New team members find the onboarding confusing, there's no guided tour and the docs are out of date for the current UI.
The Android app is noticeably slower than iOS, task lists take 5+ seconds to load. Our field team is getting frustrated.
We got charged twice for the same billing cycle. Need a refund and clarity on why this happened, quite urgent for our finance team.
It would help a lot to have push notifications on mobile when someone assigns me a task, right now I only find out by checking manually.
Can we get a native integration with Google Calendar so task due dates show up automatically? Would save a lot of manual entry.
Our account was locked after a password reset attempt and support took over 24 hours to restore access. This felt like a serious security gap.
The dashboard charts don't let us filter by custom date ranges, only last 7/30 days. We need quarterly reporting for leadership.
Mobile app keeps logging me out every morning, have to re-enter my password daily. Very disruptive for our on-call nurses.
Would love a Microsoft Teams integration similar to the Slack one, since our whole org is on Teams not Slack.
